text.tspan: MASS UPDATE
@unhappychoice carpet-bombs 20+ repos with dependency updates. No package left behind.
GLIBC CRISIS
@unhappychoice defuses glibc 2.17 time bomb hidden inside sysinfo 0.40 upgrade.
SATURDAY SURGE
@unhappychoice logs 985 commit events in a single day. Scientists scramble to explain.
RUBBER STAMP
@unhappychoice approves 58 PRs in one week. Fingers reportedly still intact.
LLM PRICES UPDATED
@unhappychoice syncs LLM pricing from LiteLLM. Anthropic execs reportedly nervous.
FIVE RELEASES
@unhappychoice ships mdts, splashboard, cycle-flyer, DroidFlyer, and Norimaki in 7 days.
SECURITY ALERT
@unhappychoice overrides vulnerable ws and glob in cycle-flyer. Hackers weep.
SKILL UNLOCKED
@unhappychoice codifies dependabot-merge into Claude skills. The robots are learning.
